facts.text: ISO 3450 covers braking for wheeled and high-speed rubber-tracked machines.
facts.quote: ISO 3450 for wheeled and high-speed rubber-tracked machines

facts.text: ISO 10265 covers braking for crawlers at 20 km/h or less.
facts.quote: ISO 10265 for crawlers at 20 km/h or less.

facts.text: For wheeled machines, the essential local states are wheel slip, normal load, and longitudinal and lateral tire forces.
facts.quote: For wheeled machines the essential local states are wheel slip, normal load and the longitudinal and lateral tire forces.

facts.text: For crawlers, track-ground force is distributed over a long contact patch.
facts.quote: For crawlers, track-ground force is distributed over a long contact patch

facts.text: For crawlers, sinkage, grouser-soil shear, differential track speed, skid steering and counter-rotation matter to machine motion and braking.
facts.quote: sinkage, grouser-soil shear, differential track speed, skid steering and counter-rotation matter.

facts.text: ISO/PRF 21815-5 was at proof stage in October 2026.
facts.quote: ISO/PRF 21815-5, at proof stage in October 2026

facts.text: The draft ISO/PRF 21815-5 was expected in November 2026.
facts.quote: ISO/PRF 21815-5, at proof stage in October 2026 and expected in November 2026

facts.text: The draft ISO/PRF 21815-5 names differential speed, skid turning and counter rotation as collision-relevant forms of motion to be handled by speed reduction, stopping or motion inhibit.
facts.quote: names "differential speed, skid turning [and] counter rotation" as collision-relevant forms of motion to be handled by speed reduction, stopping or motion inhibit.
